Diese Erklärung beschreibt, wie personen: This policy explains how personal data is processed when you use Wolkenworte, from the shared word cloud to the optional order of a personalised printed product.
Diese Erklärung gilt für die Wolkenworte: This policy applies to the Wolkenworte website, the creation and use of events, the live word cloud, and the configuration and optional ordering of personalised products. The policy published there applies to the public JUSA website:
Beim Erstellen einer Wortwolke verarbeit: When a word cloud is created, we process the chosen title, the requested address label, the event address generated from it, the creation time and the design theme.
Die Verarbeitung erfolgt zur Bereitstell: Processing is carried out to provide and manage the requested event on the basis of Article 6(1)(b) GDPR and to protect administrative functions on the basis of Article 6(1)(f) GDPR.
Teilnehmende benötigen kein Konto. Beim: Participants do not need an account. When an event is opened, a real-time connection is established and the event code is processed technically. Submitted words are normalised, assigned to the event and stored with their frequency and latest update time. To let participants remove their own contribution, each contribution is also linked to a random technical browser-session identifier. Wolkenworte does not store a link to a named person and does not create participant profiles.
Der Titel und die Wortwolke sind für all: The title and the word cloud are visible to anyone who knows the event link. The randomly generated identifier in the address makes guessing harder but does not replace access control. Do not submit confidential information, special categories of personal data or content about other people without the required authorisation.
Startet die verwaltende Person eine neue: When the event administrator starts a new round, the current words are archived and the visible word cloud is cleared. Processing supports the requested live function and collaborative event experience on the basis of Article 6(1)(f) GDPR.
Wenn eine Wortwolke als Produkt gestalte: When a word cloud is designed as a product, we store an immutable snapshot of the words together with the product, quantity, colour theme, layout, edits and technical print dimensions. A print file is generated from this data. The configuration remains independent of later contributions so the preview, payment and production use the same design.
Die Verarbeitung erfolgt zur Vorbereitun: Processing is carried out to prepare and fulfil the requested order pursuant to Article 6(1)(b) GDPR.
Für die Preisberechnung verarbeiten wir: For price calculation, we process first and last name, street and house number, optional address line 2, postal code, city, country and, where required, state or region. We also store products, quantities per shipping address, price components, currency, validity period and a random quote identifier.
Die Lieferadresse, Produktvarianten und: The shipping address, product variants and quantities are sent to Printful to calculate production, shipping and tax costs. Products going to the same address are priced together for that address. When real ordering is enabled later, Printful will also receive the order and print data required for production and delivery. In the current test-payment mode, no Printful order is created after payment; however, the price calculation deliberately started beforehand already uses Printful when the service is configured.
Anbieter ist Printful. Printful kann je: The provider is Printful. Depending on the processing, Printful may act as a processor or as an independent controller. Further information is available in Printful’s
. Die Verarbeitung ist zur Angebotserste: . Processing is required to prepare the quote and perform the contract pursuant to Article 6(1)(b) GDPR.
Für Zahlungen nutzen wir den von Stripe: We use Stripe-hosted Checkout for payments. We send Stripe the total amount, currency, a product description, and technical order, quote and configuration identifiers. Stripe processes payment-instrument data, IP address, device and fraud-prevention data and, where applicable, contact and billing data. We do not receive complete card details.
Wir erhalten von Stripe insbesondere die: From Stripe, we receive in particular checkout and payment references, payment status, amount, currency and payment time. Stripe may also process data under its own responsibility for legal, regulatory, security and fraud-prevention purposes.
Für Kunden im Europäischen Wirtschaftsra: For customers in the European Economic Area, Irish Stripe entities are involved in particular. Details are available in Stripe’s
. The legal basis is Article 6(1)(b) GDPR; we process legally required records pursuant to Article 6(1)(c) GDPR.
Wolkenworte verwendet ausschließlich ein: Wolkenworte uses only a technically necessary language-preference cookie. No analytics or advertising trackers are used.
Im Session Storage wird eine zufällige,: A random event-specific session identifier is stored in Session Storage. Its sole purpose is to show this browser its own word contributions and allow only those contributions to be removed.
Soweit Anbieter Daten außerhalb des Euro: Where providers process data outside the European Economic Area, the requirements of Articles 44 et seq. GDPR apply. Depending on the provider, transfers rely in particular on an adequacy decision such as the EU–US Data Privacy Framework or on EU Standard Contractual Clauses with supplementary safeguards.
Nach Maßgabe der DSGVO hast du insbesond: Under the GDPR, you have in particular the rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and objection. You may withdraw consent at any time with future effect. Where processing is based on Article 6(1)(f) GDPR, you may object on grounds relating to your particular situation.
Du hast außerdem das Recht, dich bei ein: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data-protection supervisory authority. The State Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information of Baden-Württemberg is one authority responsible for us.

Der Admin-PIN wird nicht im Klartext ges: The admin PIN is not stored in plain text; it is cryptographically derived with an individual salt. It is transmitted, checked and then discarded only for the relevant reset attempt; Wolkenworte does not issue a reusable admin token.
Zum Schutz vor automatisierten PIN-Versu: To protect against automated PIN attempts, the normalized IP address is pseudonymized with a secret key. Only this non-reversible check value, the number of failed attempts and the temporary block are stored.
Diese Speicherung ist für die ausdrückli: This storage is necessary for the functions expressly requested. The legal basis is Section 25(2)(2) TDDDG and Article 6(1)(f) GDPR.

Wolkenworte ist ein Online-Angebot der J: Wolkenworte is an online service of JUSA Engineering UG (haftungsbeschränkt) for interactive word clouds and optional personalised printed products.
Wolkenworte wird unter wolkenworte.io üb: Wolkenworte is provided at wolkenworte.io through Fly.io, Inc. The current application instance runs in Frankfurt am Main. Fly.io processes connection and log data technically required to deliver and secure the service, in particular the IP address, date and time, requested address, browser and device information, and error and security data.
Anwendungsdaten sowie private Bild- und: Application data and private image and print files are stored in a Postgres database and private object store provided by Supabase, Inc. The application uses encrypted connections and accesses the database through a restricted technical role.
Unsere strukturierten Anwendungsprotokol: Our structured application logs contain only approved technical identifiers and status, duration and error information. Shipping addresses, buyer email addresses, message content and raw IP addresses are not logged there. Fly.io and Supabase also maintain their own operational and security logs under their terms. Processing is necessary to provide the requested functions under Article 6(1)(b) GDPR and for secure, stable operation under Article 6(1)(f) GDPR.
Weitere Informationen findest du in den: Further information is available in the privacy notices of
Für erforderliche Bestell-, Versand-, Er: We use Resend, a service of Plus Five Five, Inc., for required order, shipping, refund and cancellation messages. The sender, buyer email address, subject and immutable HTML and text content of the message are sent to Resend. We also process the message identifier and delivery events reported by Resend so that we can trace delivery and handle errors. Open and click tracking is disabled.
Resend speichert Nachrichtendaten und Zu: Resend stores message data and delivery logs in the United States. The EU sending region selected for the sending domain determines the technical delivery route, not where this data is stored. According to Resend, transfers rely on EU Standard Contractual Clauses and the EU–US Data Privacy Framework. In the hosted test environment, required transactional emails for manual test orders are sent through Resend and clearly marked as test messages. Further information is available in Resend's
Die Verarbeitung ist für die Vertragsdur: Processing is necessary for contract performance under Article 6(1)(b) GDPR and for reliable evidence and technical safeguarding of delivery under Article 6(1)(f) GDPR.
Personenbezogene Daten erhalten nur Stel: Personal data is received only by parties that need it for the purposes described: Fly.io for application hosting and network operation, Supabase for the database and private object store, Printful for pricing and, when real ordering is enabled, production and shipping, Stripe for payment processing, and Resend for required transactional emails.
Unvollendete Adress- und Preisangebote s: Incomplete address and price quotes are valid for between 5 and 120 minutes, with a default of 30 minutes. Expired, unused quotes are automatically removed after a one-day technical grace period. Paid print files are retained for at least 90 days after submission or 60 days after delivery; a support hold may extend retention.
Daten bezahlter oder begonnener Bestellu: We retain data from paid or initiated orders, in particular payment, shipping, email and provider records, for as long as required for contract performance, processing, warranties, legal defence and commercial and tax retention obligations. Binding deletion periods for these records will be defined from the applicable tax and legal requirements and implemented technically before live sales are enabled. Fly.io's, Supabase's, Stripe's, Printful's and Resend's respective retention and deletion periods also apply.
Wir aktualisieren diese Erklärung, wenn: We update this policy when Wolkenworte, the providers used or the legal requirements change materially. Before live sales are enabled, the tax and commercial-law retention periods required for order records will in particular be finalised.
Zusätzlich werden rein funktionale Kennz: Purely functional flags are also stored in Session Storage so that the creating device can show the one-time setup notice. The selected language is stored in a functional cookie; basket drafts are stored locally so they remain available on later page views and when moving between configuration and the shipping address. The admin PIN is not stored in the browser.

Informationen zur Bestellung personalisi: Information about ordering personalised products from Wolkenworte.
Du gestaltest deine Produkte, legst sie: You design your products, add them to the basket and enter the delivery address. The shop presentation is not yet a binding contractual offer. By finally confirming the order with an obligation to pay during checkout, you place a binding order. We accept your order when payment is successfully completed; the contract is then formed. We confirm it afterwards by email.
Vor der verbindlichen Bestellung kannst: Before placing a binding order, you can check and change products, designs, quantities and the delivery address on our pages. You can return to the shop from Stripe to do so. Changes trigger a new price and delivery check. Simply opening the payment page does not place an order.
Der bei Stripe vor der verbindlichen Bes: The total price shown at Stripe before you place a binding order includes the calculated VAT and the stated shipping costs. Payment is made through Stripe by card or, if offered on the payment page, by PayPal. Card wallets offered there may also be used. Payment is collected during the ordering process.
Printful stellt die Produkte nach deiner: Printful makes the products using your design and ships them directly to the delivery address provided. We show the available estimated delivery time for your order before purchase and include it in the order confirmation. Products may arrive in multiple shipments. Your contracting party remains JUSA Engineering UG (haftungsbeschränkt).
Die Produkte werden nach deinen individu: The products are made to your individual specifications. For goods that are not prefabricated and whose production is governed by your individual choice or specification, there is generally no statutory right of withdrawal (§ 312g(2)(1) German Civil Code). Your statutory rights in the event of defects remain unaffected.
Für Änderungs- oder Stornierungswünsche: For changes or cancellation requests after ordering, contact us as soon as possible at kontakt@jusa.io with your order number. We will check whether production can still be stopped or changed; we cannot guarantee a voluntary cancellation. Please also contact us about damaged or defective products. Your statutory rights concerning defects and other mandatory consumer rights remain unaffected.
Du kannst auf Deutsch, Englisch, Französ: You can order in German, English, French, Italian, Spanish or Turkish. Your order confirmation uses the language selected when starting payment. We store the order data and the contents of the confirmation. That email contains the contractual information and you can save or print it. We do not offer a customer account with permanent access to the contract text; you can request a copy at kontakt@jusa.io.
Wenn du die Lieferung prüfen lässt, über: When you ask us to check delivery, we send the delivery address, product variants and quantities to Printful to determine production, shipping and tax costs and delivery options. This happens before an order is placed. After a real paid order, Printful also receives the order and print data needed for production and delivery.
Wenn du „Preise und Lieferung prüfen“ au: When you select ‘Check prices and delivery’, we send your name and delivery address, product and shipping amounts, currency, product description and technical order identifiers to Stripe to calculate tax and the final total and prepare the payment page. Stripe also uses the delivery address to calculate tax. When you later open the payment page, Stripe additionally processes payment instrument data, IP address, device and fraud-prevention data, contact details and, where applicable, billing details. We do not receive full card details.
Resend speichert Nachrichtendaten und Zu: Resend stores message data and delivery logs in the USA. The EU sending region determines the technical sending route, not the storage location. Resend cites EU Standard Contractual Clauses and the EU-US Data Privacy Framework as transfer bases. Further information about safeguards is available in
Empfänger sind Fly.io für Hosting, Supab: Recipients are Fly.io for hosting, Supabase for the database and private file storage, Printful and the shipping providers used for production and delivery, Stripe for payment and tax calculation, and Resend for order messages. You must provide the delivery and contact details needed for the order so we can process it.
Informationen zu den jeweiligen Übermitt: You can request information about the applicable transfer bases and a copy of the relevant safeguards at kontakt@jusa.io; further details are available in the provider information linked above.
Wir aktualisieren diese Erklärung, wenn: We update this policy when Wolkenworte, its providers or the legal requirements change significantly.
Veranstaltungen, aktuelle und archiviert: Events, current and archived words and technical contribution records are automatically deleted 365 days after the event was created. Unpaid product configurations are also removed unless they are still needed to clarify an unresolved order.
Steuerlich erforderliche Bestell- und Za: Order and payment records required for tax purposes, including necessary address details, are generally retained for eight years after the end of the relevant calendar year. Order and refund confirmations also serve as supporting records and are retained for eight years; shipping and cancellation messages are generally retained for six years after year-end. Specific legal requirements may require retention for ten years or longer.
Zusätzliche betriebliche Kopien von Lief: Additional operational copies of delivery and contact details and stored product designs are removed three years after the end of the year in which processing was completed. Technical error and provider details that are no longer needed are removed after 90 days. Checkouts confirmed as unpaid are deleted 30 days after their confirmed expiry; uncertain payment cases remain protected until resolved. These shorter periods do not affect legally required records.
Offene Reklamationen, Erstattungen, Rech: Open complaints, refunds, disputes or audits may extend retention of the required data. Related deletion holds are reviewed regularly. Data held by Fly.io, Supabase, Stripe, PayPal, Printful and Resend is also subject to their respective retention and deletion periods; deletion in our application does not automatically remove copies stored by those providers.

Mit deiner Einwilligung nutzen wir Googl: With your consent, we use Google Analytics to understand page views and important steps up to an order. The website also works without analytics. Read more in our privacy notice.

Wenn du zustimmst, verarbeitet Google An: If you agree, Google Analytics 4 processes page views and selected steps such as product selection, basket activity, price checks and confirmed orders. We send general page types instead of individual event links or names. We do not send words, delivery addresses, email addresses, PINs or Stripe session IDs to Google.
Google Analytics setzt die Cookies _ga u: Google Analytics uses the _ga and _ga_* cookies to distinguish browsers and visits; they expire after no more than 180 days. We store your choice for 180 days in a separate cookie without a user identifier. Google also processes technical connection and device data and the approximate origin of the visit. Further processing outside the European Economic Area is possible.
Anbieter ist Google Ireland Limited. Wir: The provider is Google Ireland Limited. We use Google Analytics only to assess use of our service and not for personalized advertising. The legal basis for analytics and access to your device is your consent under Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR and Section 25(1) TDDDG. You can withdraw it at any time using “Privacy settings” on every page; we then stop further analytics and delete the Analytics cookies in this browser. Processing before withdrawal remains lawful.
Die Aufbewahrung einzelner Ereignis- und: Individual event and user data in Google Analytics is set to be retained for two months; aggregate reports may remain available for longer. Further information is available in the
